project.title: Metagenomic analysis of the fungal diversity in two urban green areas in Warsaw (Poland)
project.description: The study aimed to compare fungal diversity between two green areas in Warsaw (Poland), i.e. Skaryszewski Park and Bielanski Forest and investigate the impact of human interference in the ecosystem in these urban spaces.
project.center_name: University of Warsaw, Faculty of Biology, Institute of Microbiology

samples: Fungal ITS2 amplicon from samples collected in Skaryszewski Park (Warsaw, Poland)
Fungal ITS2 amplicon from samples collected in Bielanski Forest (Warsaw, Poland)
environmental sample from a non-urban site
runs: Fungal ITS2 amplicon from samples collected in Skaryszewski Park (Warsaw, Poland)
Fungal ITS2 amplicon from samples collected in Bielanski Forest (Warsaw, Poland)
